name: edunova-x

scripts.//dev-scripts: LOCAL DEVELOPMENT ONLY. `concurrently` is never used in production: on Render each service (API / AI) is its own web service with its own start command.
scripts.start:dev: concurrently -n "frontend,server,ai" -c "cyan,green,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix frontend -- --host 0.0.0.0" "npm start --prefix server" "npm run start:ai"
scripts.start:web: concurrently -n "frontend,server" -c "cyan,green" "npm run dev --prefix frontend -- --host 0.0.0.0" "npm start --prefix server"
scripts.start:ngrok: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm start --prefix server
scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix signaling

//dependencies: Root = desktop launcher + maintenance scripts ONLY. The Express API's dependencies live in server/package.json and MUST NOT be duplicated here: root copies get hoisted into the module resolution path and silently mask a missing server install (this is what produced 'Cannot find module nodemailer' on Render).
//devDependencies: Desktop-app and local-dev tooling ONLY — never needed by the Render backend. Install production deps with `npm install --omit=dev` so electron's binary download is skipped entirely.
description: EduNova X desktop installer and launcher
author: EduNova X
//electron-note: electron@28's postinstall (install.js) checks ONLY the ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD *environment variable* — npm config keys are ignored. It downloads a ~100MB binary from github.com and hard-fails `npm install` on CI/Render/Cloudflare with 'RequestError: unable to verify the first certificate'. Production installs therefore use `npm install --omit=dev`, which skips electron entirely (see render.yaml and DEPLOYMENT.md). For a full dev install behind a proxy, export ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD=1 first, or run `npm run desktop:install`.
